abstract: Maintains local municipal employment commitments and public community consultation records
system_message:
You are the Community stakeholder and municipal liaison (COM), responsible for maintaining local municipal employment commitments and public community consultation records for candidate geothermal heating consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Town hall public engagement（OUTREACH）
information_points.content:
COM-OUTREACH-6WL：Nordic GeoPower Alliance recorded a Public consultation town hall attendance of 240 participants during the combined regional town hall briefings held in 2026.
COM-OUTREACH-BO5：Public consultation town hall attendance for Reykjanes District Energy Venture reached 520 participants across the combined regional town hall briefings held in 2026.
COM-OUTREACH-3Y8：According to municipal public hearing minutes from combined regional town hall briefings held in 2026, Borealis Thermal Consortium recorded a Public consultation town hall attendance of 380 participants.

information_points.title: Maintains local municipal employment commitments and public community consultation records（CIVICENG）
information_points.content:
COM-CIVICENG-780：Under the municipal community partnership agreement schedule covering construction and initial operational personnel, Borealis Thermal Consortium has committed to a Local workforce hiring share of 45%, representing the percentage of total project working hours reserved for local municipal residents.
COM-CIVICENG-TZC：Nordic GeoPower Alliance has established a Local workforce hiring share of 60% of total project working hours reserved for local municipal residents across construction and initial operational personnel.
COM-CIVICENG-G93：Reykjanes District Energy Venture has designated a Local workforce hiring share of 75% for local municipal residents out of total project working hours across construction and initial operational personnel.
